summary: Woodbury, CT steel tower built in 1911 to watch the Pomperaug Valley, 80 ft tall; town-administered and standing. Its 2018 work is called repainting by NHLR and restoration by the contractor.

facts.design: Steel tower, 80 ft from base to roof, with an open steel lattice design

access.note: In Orenaug Park. The contractor says it still welcomes hikers and visitors. A 2012 blog describes climbing the steel stairs to the top. The sources do not say whether the stairs are open for climbing today.

visit.trail_note: A 2012 blog describes taking the red trail up the hill to the tower, reached from the park entrance on Park Road. The same blog describes climbing the tower's steel stairs to the top.

events.note: Built in 1911 to watch for fires in the Pomperaug Valley. NHLR, the town map and the contractor agree on the year.
Repainted in 2018 (NHLR and contractor agree). The contractor also calls the work a restoration with sandblasting and steel repairs; NHLR says it has not been restored.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on January 2, 2026 as US 1807, CT 2

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the tower has not been restored and was only repainted in 2018. The contractor's own project page describes the 2018 job as a restoration with sandblasting, steel repairs and a new coating. Both agree on the 2018 repainting. The story reports both views.
The register gives the site at 504 ft (154 m). The contractor and a 2012 blog put the hilltop at 540 ft. These may measure different points, so the story gives both figures and picks neither.

notes_for_editor: height_m 24.4 is our conversion of the register's 80 ft. Casali Companies is the contractor for the 2018 work, and its page is self-description, so its restoration claims are only its own. The 1911 quote from the town map PDF comes from extracted text with broken columns; check it by eye if it matters. No staffing history or fire events were found in the sources read. The town or a local history collection may hold staffing records.
